key_lessons: Always benchmark under real concurrent load, not single-user tests
Connection pool limits are infrastructure bottlenecks (PostgreSQL max_connections=200)
Atomic DB operations outperform explicit locks for simple decrements
Cache hit rate > 80% is the target for production systems
Thread pool size should match external service capacity, not CPU cores
